large_source_relocation.symptom: Individual shard symlinks outside the source directory correctly failed the loader containment check before package writing.
large_source_relocation.correction: Relocated the complete verified source tree, preserving real shard files within the resolved source directory.
large_source_relocation.reusable_lesson: Keep configuration, index and physical shards in the same resolved source tree when relocating large downloads.

process_control.observed_issue: An OS signal targeting a process ID observed through /proc returned ProcessLookupError.
process_control.authoritative_followup: The exec tool session reported the export still running; no pause marker was written and no model output was removed.
process_control.reusable_lesson: Control long-running jobs through their owning tool session; do not rely on an unvalidated process ID from a separate execution context.
